lead: A TDS request counted in packets is not a request.
body: A case that splits `Script`'s recorded bytes at every header and counts requests passes on short values and fails the moment one is `nvarchar(max)`, because one `sp_prepexec` past the negotiated packet size leaves as several packets. Reassemble to `Status::EOM` before counting — `crates/nvs-db/src/tds/testing.rs`'s `flushed` is the helper — and keep the first packet's status, since that is the one `Status::RESET_CONNECTION` rides.
